items.title: Lonely Planet picks Dessau for 2027
items.text: Lonely Planet’s Best in Travel 2027 names Dessau among its 25 places to visit, the only German destination on the list. It singles out the Bauhaus building, the Masters’ Houses and the Törten housing estate.

items.title: 100 years of the Bauhaus building
items.text: The Bauhaus building opened on 4 December 1926. The Stiftung Bauhaus Dessau marks the centenary with “Projections | Promises | Echo” at the building on 4 and 5 December, closing two years of jubilee events.

items.title: Exhibition: Glas | Beton | Metall
items.text: In the historic workshop wing, an exhibition looks at the industrial materials the Bauhaus building is made of, which Gropius saw replacing traditional ones.

items.title: City environmental prize for a kindergarten
items.text: This year’s environmental prize of Dessau-Roßlau focused on species diversity in kindergartens. Five childcare centres were honoured at the zoo, and the prize went to the Kita “Buratino”.

items.title: The Rathaus in another 125 years
items.text: For the town hall’s 125th birthday, the city asked children how it might look 125 years from now. A ten-year-old won the drawing competition.
